nodes.label: LoopGuard Cloud Design System
nodes.rationale: The interface is dark because it is a monitoring surface, not for decorative glow; green/amber/red are semantic statuses only and must pair with an icon or text label.

nodes.label: OKLCH Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: tokens.css is the portable OKLCH source and src/theme.ts holds converted opaque sRGB values; raw colour values may appear only in the token module.
